title: A deploy from a liquidity-pool address: included, trapped
pattern: The host refuses SC_ADDRESS_TYPE_LIQUIDITY_POOL anywhere (CAP-0067); the transaction is still in the ledger. wallet-backend#745.

hazards.placement: Soroban failure: trapped on a refused address kind

facts.says: The call fails: the host traps.
